title: The results of the 2026 Developer Survey are here!
attributed_claim_summary: Stack Overflow published 2026 survey findings; its separate optional workplace-AI item reports 11,509 of 17,464 respondents selecting coding assistants/agents and 4,582 selecting agents/automated workflows.
evidence_or_event: Original 2026 survey overview; exact optional-question counts in https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-select and 30,903 overall valid survey responses in https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/methodology.
limitations: Promoted voluntary survey, not a representative probability sample; question-specific denominators vary, multi-select categories overlap, self-report does not verify agent usage in repositories.
research_relevance: Define study-era exposure proxies and avoid treating a product launch, AI survey share or tool documentation as measured repository-level agent adoption.
practical_experiment: Pilot a consented, versioned agent-usage event log and compare reported use with auditable tool traces for a small task frame; record missing and disagreement rates.
